name: Multiscale Singularity Detection via Wavelet Maxima Lines
aliases: Lipschitz exponent estimation from wavelet maxima
definition: A method to detect singular points in a signal and determine their local regularity (Lipschitz exponent) by analyzing the asymptotic decay of wavelet coefficients along local maxima lines across scales.
summary: Multiscale Singularity Detection via Wavelet Maxima Lines identifies signal irregularities and quantifies their smoothness by tracking wavelet coefficient decay along local maxima lines across scales.
